name: Practiced Guidance

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Traveling to safety can be harrowing, but you are practiced at helping others along that path. When you roll a success to Aid a member of your crop, you get a critical success instead. When you roll a critical success, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check you attempt before the end of your next turn.
